title: A Spring Day at the Zoo
setting: A zoo by a river, with a small farm corner.

characters.name: Grandpa Joe
characters.look: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

sentences.en: The sky is cloudy on a rainy spring morning.
sentences.zh: 春天的一个早晨，下着雨，天空多云。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grey clouds over a zoo with blossom trees; rain falls on Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) under one big umbrella.

sentences.en: Grandpa Joe still wears his winter clothes.
sentences.zh: 乔爷爷还穿着他的冬衣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan), now wearing a thick winter coat, a wool scarf and a fur hat over his brown cardigan, walks next to Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots).

sentences.en: A baby elephant plays in the river.
sentences.scene_prompt: A baby elephant splashes water with its trunk in a zoo river; Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) watch from the fence.

sentences.en: The baby elephant is the star of the zoo.
sentences.zh: 这头小象是动物园的明星。
sentences.scene_prompt: A big crowd of visitors smiles, points and takes photos of the baby elephant.

sentences.en: A tiger sleeps among the red flowers.
sentences.zh: 一只老虎睡在红色的花丛中。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tiger sleeps among red flowers in its zoo garden.

sentences.en: He lets a little pig eat from his hand.
sentences.zh: 他让一只小猪从他手里吃东西。
sentences.scene_prompt: In the farm corner, Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) lets a little pink pig eat from his open hand while Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) laughs.

sentences.en: Lily uses a carrot to feed a brown horse.
sentences.zh: 莉莉用一根胡萝卜喂一匹棕色的马。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) holds up a carrot to a brown horse over a wooden fence.

sentences.en: Then the sun comes out, and the animals play.
sentences.zh: 然后太阳出来了，动物们玩了起来。
sentences.scene_prompt: The sun breaks through the clouds over the zoo; elephants, monkeys and goats play in the sunshine.
